_readme: Labelled descriptions for evaluating fact extraction (facts.py).
Each case labels only the fields that matter for it; unlabelled fields are
not scored. 'tier' is the tier the rule engine should reach from correct
facts — verify it with `python eval/run_eval.py --check-labels`, which runs
the labels through rules.py without calling any API.
Languages are mixed on purpose: the tool is sold for NL/FR/EN/ES intake.

cases.name: CV Screener & Ranker
cases.description: We are a software vendor. We build and sell a tool that screens and ranks job applicants for recruitment agencies across the EU. It parses CVs, scores candidates against the job requirements, and ranks them. Our customers licence it under our brand.
cases.components:
- Ranking model fine-tuned on past hiring decisions
- PostgreSQL (candidates, scores)
- Recruiter web portal

cases.name: Hiring Assistant
cases.description: Our recruitment agency in Ghent uses a CV-screening tool we licence from an American vendor. We did not build it and we do not modify it. Recruiters use it daily to rank applicants for our clients.
cases.components:
- Vendor SaaS
- Internal recruiter dashboard

cases.name: Sollicitatie Ranker
cases.description: Wij zijn een bank in Antwerpen. Wij hebben een bestaand AI-model van een leverancier gekocht en het opnieuw getraind op onze eigen historische aanwervingsgegevens. Wij bieden het intern aan onder onze eigen merknaam.
cases.components:
- Ingekocht basismodel, bijgetraind op eigen data
- Interne HR-portaal

cases.name: Careers Chatbot
cases.description: A chatbot on our careers website that answers candidate questions about open vacancies and the application process. It makes no decisions about anyone. Candidates are not told whether they are talking to a person or to software.
cases.components:
- Web chat widget
- LLM via API, no fine-tuning
- FAQ knowledge base
cases._note: generates_synthetic_content is deliberately NOT labelled here. Whether a chatbot's text answers are 'synthetic text content' under Art. 50(2) is genuinely contested, and encoding either reading as ground truth would make the metric measure our opinion rather than the model's accuracy.

cases.name: Assistant virtuel
cases.description: Un assistant conversationnel sur notre site, présenté explicitement comme un robot avec un avatar et la mention « assistant automatique ». Il répond aux questions sur nos horaires d'ouverture. Il ne prend aucune décision concernant les personnes.
cases.components:
- Widget de chat
- Modèle de langage via API
cases._note: Art. 50(1) imposes no duty where the AI is obvious, so no transparency trigger and the tier is MINIMAL, not LIMITED.

cases.name: Workplace Mood Monitor
cases.description: A system used by an employer that infers employees' emotions from webcam video during the working day, to flag stress and disengagement to managers. It is used purely for HR productivity purposes.
cases.components:
- Webcam ingestion
- Emotion-recognition model
- Manager dashboard

cases.name: Fatigue Safety Monitor
cases.description: A system installed in a factory that detects signs of fatigue and drowsiness in machine operators, purely to prevent accidents with heavy machinery. It is put in place for safety reasons and alerts the operator directly.
cases.components:
- In-cab camera
- Drowsiness detection model
- Audible alert

cases.name: Puntuacion Ciudadana
cases.description: Un sistema que evalúa a los ciudadanos durante varios años según su comportamiento social y sus características personales, y utiliza esa puntuación para denegarles el acceso a servicios municipales no relacionados, como bibliotecas y polideportivos.
cases.components:
- Base de datos de comportamiento
- Modelo de puntuación
- Integración con servicios municipales

cases.name: FaceIndex
cases.description: A tool that continuously crawls the public internet and social media to collect face images without any targeting, building a searchable facial recognition database that customers can query.
cases.components:
- Web crawler
- Face embedding index

cases.name: Missing Persons Search
cases.description: A police force uses live facial recognition in public squares strictly to search for specific missing children reported in the previous 24 hours. Every deployment is authorised in advance by a judge, and use stops when the authorisation expires.
cases.components:
- Public CCTV feed
- Live face matching against a watchlist
- Judicial authorisation workflow

cases.name: City Watch
cases.description: A municipality runs continuous live facial recognition across all city-centre cameras to identify anyone passing through, for general policing purposes. There is no specific target and no prior authorisation for individual uses.
cases.components:
- City-wide CCTV
- Live identification against a population database

cases.name: Toegangsbadge
cases.description: Een gezichtsherkenningssysteem aan de ingang van ons kantoor dat enkel controleert of een medewerker daadwerkelijk de persoon is die hij beweert te zijn, voordat de deur opengaat. Het identificeert niemand uit een menigte.
cases.components:
- Camera aan de deur
- Vergelijking met de foto in het personeelsdossier

cases.name: CrediScore
cases.description: A model used by a consumer lender to evaluate the creditworthiness of individual loan applicants and set their credit score, which determines whether the loan is granted.
cases.components:
- Scoring model
- Loan origination system

cases.name: Detection de fraude
cases.description: Un système utilisé par notre banque uniquement pour détecter les fraudes sur les transactions par carte bancaire. Il signale les paiements suspects aux analystes. Il n'évalue pas la solvabilité des clients et ne sert pas à accorder des crédits.
cases.components:
- Modèle de détection d'anomalies sur les transactions
- File d'attente pour les analystes

cases.name: Life Underwriting Engine
cases.description: An insurer uses this model for risk assessment and pricing of life insurance policies for individual applicants, based on their health questionnaire and medical history.
cases.components:
- Underwriting risk model
- Policy pricing engine

cases.name: Tarificacion de automoviles
cases.description: Un modelo que calcula el precio de las pólizas de seguro de automóvil según el historial de siniestros del vehículo y la zona de circulación. No se utiliza para seguros de vida ni de salud.
cases.components:
- Modelo de tarificación
- Sistema de pólizas

cases.name: Toelatingssysteem
cases.description: Een systeem dat door een hogeschool wordt gebruikt om te bepalen welke kandidaten worden toegelaten tot de opleiding. Het rangschikt de aanvragers automatisch op basis van hun dossier.
cases.components:
- Rangschikkingsmodel
- Inschrijvingsportaal

cases.name: Eligibilite aux aides
cases.description: Un système utilisé par une administration publique pour évaluer l'éligibilité des personnes aux prestations d'aide sociale, et pour décider de réduire ou de retirer ces prestations.
cases.components:
- Modèle d'éligibilité
- Dossier social des bénéficiaires

cases.name: Emergency Call Triage
cases.description: A system used by an emergency call centre to classify incoming 112 calls and set the dispatch priority for ambulances and fire crews.
cases.components:
- Speech classification model
- Dispatch priority queue

cases.name: Offender Risk Predictor
cases.description: A system that predicts how likely an individual is to commit a crime, based only on profiling them and assessing their personality traits. There is no underlying objective evidence linking the person to any criminal activity.
cases.components:
- Personality and demographic profiling model
- Risk score dashboard

cases.name: Investigation Support
cases.description: A tool that helps investigators weigh evidence already gathered about a suspect's involvement in a specific crime. It supports the human assessment and works from objective, verifiable facts directly linked to the criminal activity under investigation.
cases.components:
- Evidence correlation engine
- Investigator review interface
cases._note: predictive_policing_profiling_only is deliberately NOT labelled. A system working from objective verifiable facts is arguably not 'based solely on profiling' at all, so both true (trigger, then exception) and false (never triggered) are defensible readings and the case would measure our opinion rather than accuracy.

cases.name: Verificacion de asilo
cases.description: Un sistema utilizado por las autoridades de fronteras para evaluar las solicitudes de asilo y verificar la documentación de las personas que solicitan entrar en el país.
cases.components:
- Modelo de evaluación de solicitudes
- Verificación documental

cases.name: Judgment Assistant
cases.description: A tool used by a court to research and interpret facts and law, and to assist a judicial authority in applying the law to a concrete set of facts in a case.
cases.components:
- Case-law retrieval
- Draft reasoning generator

cases.name: Netbeheer
cases.description: Een AI-systeem dat wordt gebruikt als veiligheidscomponent bij het beheer en de exploitatie van het elektriciteitsnet. Bij een storing kan de levering aan duizenden huishoudens uitvallen.
cases.components:
- Belastingvoorspelling
- Automatische netschakeling

cases.name: Diagnostic Imaging AI
cases.description: Software that acts as a safety component of a CE-marked medical imaging device, flagging suspected tumours for the radiologist. It is sold as part of the device by the device manufacturer.
cases.components:
- Image segmentation model
- Integrated into the scanner software

cases.name: Spam Filter
cases.description: A spam filter that classifies incoming email as spam or not spam for our internal staff mailboxes. It does not interact with people, produce content, or make decisions about anyone.
cases.components:
- Text classifier
- Mail server integration

cases.name: Maintenance predictive
cases.description: Un modèle qui prédit les pannes de nos machines d'usine à partir des données de vibration des capteurs, afin de planifier la maintenance. Il ne concerne aucune personne physique.
cases.components:
- Capteurs de vibration
- Modèle de prédiction de pannes

cases.name: Marketing Image Generator
cases.description: A tool our marketing team uses to generate entirely new promotional images from text prompts. The output is published on social media.
cases.components:
- Diffusion model via API
- Asset library

cases.name: Copy Assistant
cases.description: An assistant that corrects spelling and grammar in text our staff have already written. It only performs standard editing and does not substantially change the meaning or the content of what the user wrote.
cases.components:
- Grammar correction model
- Word processor plugin

cases.name: Generador satirico
cases.description: Una aplicación que crea vídeos manipulados de personajes públicos con fines claramente satíricos y humorísticos, publicados en un programa de comedia reconocido como tal.
cases.components:
- Modelo de sustitución facial
- Editor de vídeo

cases.name: Newsroom Drafter
cases.description: Our newsroom uses AI to draft articles on matters of public interest. Every article is reviewed and edited by a human journalist, and our editor-in-chief holds editorial responsibility for everything we publish.
cases.components:
- Draft generation via LLM API
- Editorial review workflow

cases.name: Foundation Model
cases.description: We train our own large general-purpose language model from scratch on a very large corpus and release it for other companies to build products on.
cases.components:
- Training cluster
- Model weights distributed to customers

cases.name: US Internal HR Tool
cases.description: A United States company uses an internal AI tool to rank job applicants for its US offices only. The company has no establishment in the EU, no EU customers, and none of the output is used in the European Union. All candidates are based in the US.
cases.components: - Internal ranking model

cases.name: Offshore Screening Service
cases.description: A company based in India screens job applicants on behalf of European employers. The rankings it produces are sent to and used by the client companies in Belgium and the Netherlands to decide who gets interviewed.
cases.components:
- Screening model
- Client reporting portal

cases.name: Defensiesysteem
cases.description: Een AI-systeem dat uitsluitend wordt gebruikt voor militaire en defensiedoeleinden door het ministerie van Defensie. Het wordt niet commercieel aangeboden en heeft geen civiele toepassing.
cases.components:
- Doelherkenning
- Militair netwerk

cases.name: Prototype de recherche
cases.description: Un modèle développé et mis en service par une université dans le seul but de la recherche scientifique et du développement. Il n'est pas commercialisé et n'est utilisé sur aucun dossier réel.
cases.components:
- Notebook de recherche
- Jeu de données académique

cases.name: Pre-launch Prototype
cases.description: We are developing a credit scoring model. It is still in research and testing in our lab before being placed on the market. It is not used on real customers and no decisions are made with it.
cases.components:
- Development environment
- Synthetic test data

cases.name: Home Photo Sorter
cases.description: An individual uses an app on their own phone to sort personal holiday photos by who appears in them. This is purely a personal, non-professional activity with no business use.
cases.components: - On-device photo clustering

cases.name: Ingevoerd HR-systeem
cases.description: Wij zijn een Belgisch bedrijf dat een AI-wervingssysteem van een Amerikaanse fabrikant invoert en op de Europese markt aanbiedt. Het draagt de merknaam van de Amerikaanse fabrikant, niet de onze.
cases.components:
- Distributieovereenkomst
- Lokale ondersteuning

cases.name: Payroll Calculator
cases.description: A deterministic spreadsheet macro that multiplies hours worked by the hourly rate and applies a fixed tax table. It follows rules written by our accountant and does not learn or infer anything.
cases.components:
- Excel macro
- Fixed tax lookup table

cases.name: Nudge Widget
cases.description: A widget that uses persuasive design to encourage users to complete their profile on our site. It is mildly manipulative but the worst outcome is an incomplete profile — nobody suffers any significant harm.
cases.components:
- A/B tested prompts
- Profile completion tracker

cases.name: Clasificador biometrico
cases.description: Un sistema que analiza las imágenes faciales de las personas para deducir su origen étnico y sus opiniones políticas, con el fin de segmentar la publicidad.
cases.components:
- Modelo de análisis facial
- Motor de segmentación publicitaria
